text: Janet Louise Hubert (born January 13, 1956) is an American film and television actress and dancer best known for playing the original Vivian Banks on the sitcom The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air from its first season in 1990 until the end of its third season in 1993. She was nominated for an NAACP Image Award for Outstanding Actress in a Comedy Series in 1991 for her performance. Her role as Mignon on the digital series King Ester earned her a Daytime Emmy Award nomination in 2020. Hubert was born in Chicago, Illinois, and spent her early years growing up on Chicago's South Side; at age nine, she moved with her family to rural Chicago. She won a scholarship to the Juilliard School in New York City but did not complete her studies. After performing in the national tour of Dancin', she made her Broadway debut in 1981 in the ensemble of The First, a musical about Jackie Robinson. She created the role of Tantomile in the original Broadway production of Cats and also understudied Grizabella and Demeter. She left Cats in April 1983 to join the national tour of Sophisticated Ladies, opposite Dee Dee Bridgewater and Gregg Burge. After being allegedly fired by the show's creators, Hubert's character, Aunt Viv, was recast and played by Daphne Maxwell Reid for the remainder of the series. Will Smith, the show's star, claimed that Hubert "brought her problems to work," and rumors suggested he fired her due to this, though Hubert has denied this, stating she left after being told she had two months and a half left on set and could not work on another project. Her role as Aunt Viv was subsequently played by Daphne Maxwell Reid. Hubert appeared in a 2002 episode of Friends as Chandler's boss. In 2005, she began playing the recurring role of Lisa Williamson, mother of attorney Evangeline Williamson, on One Life to Live, with occasional appearances since then. She appeared as Michel Gerard's mother in an episode of Gilmore Girls and has made appearances on episodes of All My Children, NYPD Blue, The Bernie Mac Show, and Tyler Perry's House of Payne. In November 2018, it was announced she had been cast on General Hospital, where she made her debut as Yvonne on December 7, 2018. Hubert appeared in The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air Reunion on HBO Max in November 2020, where she and Smith spoke for the first time since her departure. Hubert discussed personal issues, including domestic violence, and clarified she had not been fired. Smith admitted he was neither "sensitive" nor "perceptive" at the time, attributing his behavior to being "very young" and "immature," and stated that being a parent had taught him to understand her situation, apologizing for his actions. Hubert then joined the rest of the guests at the reunion. She appeared on FX's Pose in season 3 as a family member of Billy Porter's character, Pray Tell, alongside Jackée Harry and Anna Maria Horsford. In 2022, she appeared on The Ms. Pat Show as the title character's mother-in-law, Jewell. In 1990, Hubert married James Whitten, who was verbally and physically abusive toward her until their separation in 1994; from this marriage, she gave birth to a son, Elijah Isaac Whitten. She has been married to Larry Kraft since 2005. Hubert suffers from osteoporosis and serves as ambassador for the National Osteoporosis Foundation.
